classification.difficultyReason: Read the supplied equality markings and select a taught congruence test, distinguishing an included angle for SAS from a right angle with a marked hypotenuse for RHS. No additional geometric facts need deriving.

content.prompt: Pick the congruence test (SSS, SAS, AAS or RHS) for each pair of congruent triangles.

spec.description: Two narrow triangles with the same orientation; three ticks on each vertical side, two on each upper slope and one on each lower slope.
spec.mathematics: Three pairs of corresponding sides are equal.

answer.worked: All three pairs of corresponding sides are equal. Correct answer: SSS.

spec.description: Paired right triangles with two-tick hypotenuses and one-tick legs; right-angle squares at the upper-right vertex of the left triangle and lower-left vertex of the right triangle.
spec.mathematics: Equal hypotenuses and one corresponding leg in right triangles.

answer.worked: Both triangles are right-angled, with equal hypotenuses and one other pair of corresponding sides equal. Correct answer: RHS.

spec.description: Differently oriented paired triangles. One-tick and two-tick sides meet at a dot-marked angle in each.
spec.mathematics: Two corresponding sides and their included angles are equal.

answer.worked: Two pairs of corresponding sides and the included angles are equal. Correct answer: SAS.

spec.description: Upward and downward triangles with one corresponding side tick and corresponding open-circle and filled-dot angle markers.
spec.mathematics: Two pairs of angles and a corresponding non-included side are equal.

answer.worked: Two pairs of corresponding angles and one pair of corresponding sides are equal. Correct answer: AAS.

spec.description: Paired triangles with one-tick and two-tick sides meeting at corresponding filled-dot angles.
spec.mathematics: Two pairs of corresponding sides and included angles are equal.

answer.worked: Two pairs of corresponding sides and the included angles are equal. Correct answer: SAS.

spec.description: Downward and leftward triangles. A one-tick side joins the filled-dot and cross-marked angles in each.
spec.mathematics: Two pairs of corresponding angles and their corresponding included sides are equal; the taught test is called AAS.

answer.worked: Two pairs of corresponding angles and one pair of corresponding sides are equal. Correct answer: AAS.

spec.description: Oppositely oriented right triangles with two ticks on vertical legs and one tick on hypotenuses.
spec.mathematics: Equal hypotenuses and corresponding legs in right triangles.

answer.worked: Both triangles are right-angled, with equal hypotenuses and one other pair of corresponding sides equal. Correct answer: RHS.

spec.description: Right triangles with one-tick and two-tick legs meeting at the marked right angle; hypotenuses unmarked.
spec.mathematics: Two equal corresponding legs and included right angles give SAS.

answer.worked: Two pairs of corresponding sides and their included right angles are equal. Correct answer: SAS.

spec.description: Paired oblique triangles with corresponding one-, two- and three-tick sides; no angle marks.
spec.mathematics: Three corresponding pairs of sides are equal.

answer.worked: All three pairs of corresponding sides are equal. Correct answer: SSS.

spec.description: Rotated paired right triangles with one-tick hypotenuses and two-tick legs.
spec.mathematics: Equal hypotenuses and another corresponding side in right triangles.

answer.worked: Both triangles are right-angled, with equal hypotenuses and one other pair of corresponding sides equal. Correct answer: RHS.

spec.description: Paired oblique triangles with corresponding filled-dot and small open-square angle markers; one tick on a non-included corresponding side. The small squares are free-standing equal-angle symbols, not corner right-angle constructions.
spec.mathematics: Two corresponding angles and one corresponding side are equal.

answer.worked: Two pairs of corresponding angles and one pair of corresponding sides are equal. Correct answer: AAS.

spec.description: Upward and downward triangles, with corresponding one-tick horizontal, two-tick and three-tick sloping sides.
spec.mathematics: Three pairs of corresponding sides are equal.

answer.worked: All three pairs of corresponding sides are equal. Correct answer: SSS.
